attributes.context: Appears in Article 8 Management, alongside management rights to manage jobs, retain or dispense with employees, and determine reasonable employment qualifications.

extraction_text: The employee shall use any tool, equipment, machinery, new material and products or procedure of his craft required by the Employer.

attributes.context: Article 8 Management also provides that there shall be no limit on production or restriction on the full use of proper tools or equipment.
